'''Joli Ti Eddawan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and the daughter of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Galim Eddawan]] who represented [[Tyan]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. In [[76 BBY/Legends|76 BBY]], [[Lorian Nod]] used her voice to let [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] believe that she was on his ship. Qui-Gon, being very inexperienced yet, thought a young child could die and so he tried to save her from the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. However, on the ship he only found a recorder with her voice; she and her father had been killed days before.
